public_body: Somerville Board Of Aldermen Confirmation Of Appointments And Personnel Matters Committee
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: passing a document between two members was not deliberation, and the bias and pressure claims were outside the law and declined for review.

allegations.summary: During a January 25 executive session, a non-committee alderman allegedly passed a document to a committee member who also sits on the Board of Aldermen.
allegations.key_passage: The passing of this document between these two individuals is not deliberation, as defined by the Open Meeting Law, because it is not a communication between a quorum of either the Committee or the Board of Aldermen.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged a non-committee alderman was biased against him and that a committee member pressured him to make a decision.
allegations.key_passage: Even if true, these allegations would not constitute violations of the Open Meeting Law.
